headline: Palace Orders WFH and Alternative Learning in Three Provinces for August 11
seoTitle: Palace Orders WFH, Alternative Learning in 3 Provinces for August 11
seoDescription: Malacañang ordered work-from-home arrangements for government offices and alternative learning modes in Zambales, Bataan and Occidental Mindoro on August 11.
deck: Malacañang ordered work-from-home arrangements for government offices and alternative learning modes in Zambales, Bataan and Occidental Mindoro on August 11 because of continued monsoon rain.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Malacañang ordered government offices in Zambales, Bataan and Occidental Mindoro to use work-from-home arrangements on Tuesday, August 11, because of continued heavy rain from the southwest monsoon.
Memorandum Circular No. 124 also directed schools in the three provinces to adopt alternative learning modes. The directive was signed by Acting Executive Secretary Ralph Recto.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The verified national directive covered the three provinces. The City of Manila and other local governments issued their own class and work advisories, which were separate from the nationwide Palace order.
Government agencies responsible for health services, disaster response and other essential functions were expected to maintain the personnel needed for continuous operations.

sections.heading: Why this matters to Filipinos
paragraphs: The arrangement was intended to reduce travel during hazardous weather while allowing government services and school activities to continue through remote or alternative modes.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Residents should follow later advisories from their provincial and local governments because local conditions can lead to separate suspensions, evacuation orders or changes in work and school arrangements.
